title: I just build a game with Tesana AI, submitted it to Steam and looking for testers.
author: New-Specialist6445
selftext:
Hello everyone I have just finished developing V1 of ORKHOARDE, A Free-to-Play 4 player Co-Op Action/Tower Defence game where you fight off ever increasing waves of Orks while trying to stop them from stealing your castle's gold. The game is going to soon be in early-access and at this point I am looking for game-testers and overall game feedback. Tesana is in the process of publishing my game to Steam so at this time it can only be played directly via the Tesana store page link below. Creating an account will allow you to save all your single player as well as co-op online progress across all platforms, you can also play as a guest if you want. I current have a roadmap of 6 unique DLCs planned out for the next 12 months which will each include a new hero, map and boss! There are also multiple different unique features such as as system with over 512,000 possible named champions and mega bosses that are created through randomly generated backend "roll the dice" style means. I hope that features such as this are able to provide player with endless replay value. Orks also get smarter and more organized the higher wave/difficulty you go.

Thanks in advance to anyone giving it a shot!

[PLAY ORKHOARDE FREE](https://tesana.com/game/orkhoarde)
